EXPLODED ISOMETRIC / arbitrary separation / not to scale
494 modeled part instances; quantities from manifest.
Counts describe modeled solid part instances, not purchased assemblies. Sensor, actuator
and cabinet internals are envelope models. Fixings shown are illustrative; final fastener
The part manifest retains names, categories, bounding boxes and solid volumes. The
parametric CadQuery source is the editable design definition. STEP is the checked exchange
Material grades, finishes, fabrication details, approved vendors, quantities of unmodeled
internals, torque values and acceptance tolerances are not specified.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
